main_text.l: cum utrobique non major futura fit
nullum sit medium inter duo quæ u-
si editis, bibitis & quicquam agitis id
fieri debere, habendo pro scopo & ulti-
mo fine gloriam Dei & salutem animarum:
una morum norma, una scriptura fixa
stationis, par esse ut omnes cœtus
πολίτευμα, ut loquitur St. Paulus, sit vi-
rorum piorum & fidelium; ut jam si
sti in Ecclesia usurpanda, utique sit
actus cujusvis cœtus aut societatis quæ

page.notes: Greek word "πολίτευμα" as printed in the line "eorum πο-λίτευμα" is rendered from the scan; the ligature/hyphenation at the line end is uncertain. The word "Epist." in the running head is set in italic with the number 12 in small capitals.
